academic_term_dates.name: academic_term_dates
academic_term_dates.body_sql:
SELECT
  at.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
  -- lift any literals out of the view; assume TERM_START_DATE/END_DATE stored as strings in academic_terms
  at.`TERM_START_DATE` AS `TERM_START_DATE`,
  at.`TERM_END_DATE` AS `TERM_END_DATE`,
  at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
  at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION` AS `TERM_DESCRIPTION`
FROM `academic_terms` AS at
academic_term_dates.description: Canonical term-level table exposing term codes and their start/end dates and academic year. Useful to attach term start dates to term-coded objects.
